name: octaweave_list_posts
description: List blog posts. Returns {items, next_cursor}. Each item has both `status` (what was set) and `visibility` (what a reader actually gets: draft | scheduled | live | archived) — read `visibility` when you want to know whether anyone can see it. `public_url` is null until something is published.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
